claims: McDonald's launched "KPop Demon Hunters" themed meals on March 31, 2026.
"KPop Demon Hunters" themed meals feature South Korean-inspired flavors.
"KPop Demon Hunters" themed meals feature special sauces.
"KPop Demon Hunters" themed meals feature collectible photocards.
The collaboration includes the HUNTR/X Meal.
HUNTR/X Meal is 10-pc McNuggets.
The collaboration includes the Saja Boys Breakfast Meal.
Saja Boys Breakfast Meal is Sausage McMuffin with Egg.
HUNTR/X Meal includes 10-piece Chicken McNuggets.
HUNTR/X Meal includes Medium Drink.
HUNTR/X Meal includes new Ramyeon McShaker™ Fries.
Ramyeon McShaker™ Fries have soy/garlic/sesame seasoning.
Sauces include Hunter Sauce.
Hunter Sauce is sweet chili.
Sauces include Demon Sauce.
Demon Sauce is bold purple mustard.
Derpy McFlurry is Vanilla soft serve with wild berry sauce.
Derpy McFlurry includes berry-flavored popping pearls.
Saja Boys Breakfast Meal includes Sausage McMuffin with Egg featuring a peppery Spicy Saja Sauce.
Saja Boys Breakfast Meal includes hashbrowns.
Saja Boys Breakfast Meal includes a drink.
Each meal comes with a HUNTR/X or Saja Boys photocard.
Each meal comes with a "Derpy" access card.
"Derpy" access card has a QR code.
QR code unlocks exclusive content in the McDonald's App.
The campaign highlights a "battle" between the fictional girl group HUNTR/X and the boy band Saja Boys from the 2026 animated film.
The promotion runs while supplies last.
HUNTR/X Meal and Saja Boys Breakfast Meal are available for a limited time
